title: Subprocess-Constrained Markov Decision Processes
abstract: arXiv:2611.21471v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs) typically bound expected cumulative cost from an initial state. Such a guarantee can be insufficient when a policy must remain feasible after every history it may encounter. We introduce \emph{subprocess-constrained MDPs} (S-CMDPs), which require the expected discounted cost of each continuation, conditional on any reachable history, to satisfy a bound determined by the current state. This stronger requirement changes the structure and complexity of the problem: we show that stationary policies can be strictly suboptimal, and finding even an approximately optimal stationary policy is NP-hard. We adapt a recently introduced value-set iteration framework to show that history-dependent policies surprisingly overcome both obstacles. Our polynomial-time algorithm represents such a policy implicitly: its expected reward is within $\epsilon$ of the optimal feasible value, it violates each subprocess

translated_title: 子过程约束马尔可夫决策过程
translated_abstract: 受限马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）通常只约束从初始状态出发的期望累积成本。当策略在其可能遇到的每一段历史之后都必须保持可行时，这种保证可能并不充分。我们提出了子过程约束马尔可夫决策过程（S-CMDP），它要求在任意可达历史的条件下，每一段后续过程的期望折扣成本都满足一个由当前状态决定的上界。这一更强的要求改变了问题的结构与复杂性：我们证明了平稳策略可能严格次优，且寻找即使近似最优的平稳策略也是NP难的。我们改编了最近提出的值集合迭代框架，结果显示依赖历史的策略出人意料地克服了上述两个障碍。我们的多项式时间算法隐式地表示了这类策略：其期望奖励与最优可行值之差在 $\epsilon$ 以内，且不违反每一个子过程约束。
tldr: 本文提出子过程约束马尔可夫决策过程（S-CMDP），要求在任意可达历史后的每段后续过程都满足由当前状态决定的成本上界，证明了平稳策略可能严格次优且近似求解为NP难，并基于值集合迭代给出多项式时间算法，通过隐式表示的依赖历史策略达到近似最优。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces subprocess-constrained MDPs (S-CMDPs), which require every continuation after any reachable history to satisfy a state-determined cost bound, proves that stationary policies can be strictly suboptimal and finding approximately optimal ones is NP-hard, and proposes a polynomial-time value-set iteration algorithm that implicitly represents near-optimal history-dependent policies.
